1153.description: Leaning back on the straps with your arms extended, you stretch the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Hold the handles and step back so your arms are straight.
Sit your hips back and lower your chest.
Round the upper back gently and push the straps away.
Feel the stretch between the shoulder blades.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and return.

1281.description: Press a single dumbbell up from shoulder height on an incline bench. It builds the upper chest and shoulders and evens out strength between sides.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting on your thigh.
Lie back on the bench and position the dumbbell at shoulder level, palm facing forward.
Press the dumbbell upward and slightly inward, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，放在大腿上。
仰卧在长凳上，将哑铃置于与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
将哑铃向上并稍微向内推，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1345.description: Hinge forward and row a kettlebell in each hand to your sides. It works the upper back and lats and trains grip strength.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a kettlebell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the kettlebells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，双手各握一个壶铃，手掌朝向身体。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将壶铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将壶铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1409.description: Lie on your back with a barbell across your hips and lift your hips high. It builds the glutes and the back of the thighs.
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place a barbell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Engage your glutes and core muscles, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先平躺在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
将杠铃放在臀部上，用双手牢牢握住它。
锻炼臀部和核心肌肉，然后将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1473.description: A bodyweight jump backward with a soft landing. It builds explosive power in the quads and trains control.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and jump backwards, pushing off with both feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖，向后跳跃，用双脚蹬地。
脚掌轻轻着地，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
重复所需的重复次数。

1537.description: A clean caught in a split stance instead of a squat. It trains the explosive pull and the catch.
instructions: Grip the bar just outside your legs with a flat back, shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Split your feet front and back and catch the bar on your front shoulders.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1601.description: A hamstring stretch with the heel on a stability ball, using a contract and relax method. It helps you ease deeper into the stretch.
instructions: Stand and rest one heel on a stability ball in front of you with your knee straight.
Hinge forward at the hips until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh.
Gently press your heel into the ball for about 5 seconds, then relax.
Lean a little deeper into the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1665.description: A one-arm curl lying chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the biceps on one side.
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing down.
Extend your arm fully, letting it hang straight down towards the floor.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，一只手握住哑铃，掌心朝下。
完全伸展你的手臂，让它垂直垂向地板。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向上卷曲至肩膀。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1729.description: Alternating dumbbell triceps extensions while lying down. It isolates each arm in turn.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower one dumbbell down towards your head, bending at the elbow, while keeping the other arm extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then raise the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将一个哑铃朝头部方向放下，肘部弯曲，同时保持另一只手臂伸展。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。

1793.description: Pulling one arm across your chest stretches the rear shoulder. It is a staple warm-up and cooldown stretch.
instructions: Stand tall and bring one straight arm across your chest.
Use your other hand to hold it just above the elbow and draw it closer to you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1857.description: Seated machine crunch that works the abs through a full range, loading the crunch with plates.
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles and set your feet firmly.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Pause at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight drop.

1921.description: Lying on your back, you lift one straight leg to stretch the hamstring with the lower back supported.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg toward the ceiling, holding behind the thigh or calf.
Keep the knee as straight as is comfortable and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently draw the leg toward you until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1985.description: A stretch for the rotator cuff with the elbow lifted out to the side.
instructions: Stand tall and lift one elbow out to the side, hand behind your head.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently press the elbow back and slightly down.
Feel the stretch in the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2113.description: Bends the lower trunk sideways from a standing position to stretch the muscles along the flank and low back.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Place one hand on your hip and reach the other arm overhead.
Push the hips slightly to the side opposite your reach.
Bend sideways from the waist without leaning forward or back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to upright and switch sides.

2305.description: A quick forward kick that snaps out from the knee, building leg speed and balance.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Snap your lower leg forward to the target.
Pull the leg back quickly along the same line.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.

2561.description: A side-on jump onto a bench that builds explosive leg power.
instructions: Stand beside a sturdy bench.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up and sideways onto the bench.
Land softly with your knees bent.
Step down carefully.
Repeat, alternating sides.

2689.description: A single-arm front raise with constant cable tension, training the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley with the handle in one hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and raise it forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

2753.description: A deep squat from a raised platform with a band for added resistance, training the legs and glutes.
instructions: Stand on a low platform, band under your feet and a kettlebell at your chest.
Sit down into the deepest squat you can control.
Keep your heels flat and chest up.
Push through your feet to stand.
Keep tension in the band all the way up.

2945.description: Sliding your shoulder blades along a wall to improve their control. It helps shoulder blade mobility and posture.
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your elbows bent at your sides.
Press your forearms and head lightly into the wall.
Slide your arms up the wall while keeping your shoulder blades down.
Stop before your back arches.
Slide down slowly and repeat.

3009.description: Stepping up stairs at a steady pace to train the legs and raise your heart rate.
instructions: Stand at the bottom of a staircase, standing tall.
Step up with one foot, placing your whole foot on the step.
Press through your heel and bring the other foot up.
Keep your torso upright and swing your arms naturally.
Continue at a steady pace and alternate the leading leg.

3201.description: A short-range sit-up where you curl only partway up. It keeps tension on the abs and is easier on the lower back than a full sit-up.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3265.description: A knee push-up that ends by sitting your hips back into child pose, building the chest and giving the back a stretch.
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to the start.
Push your hips back onto your heels and reach your arms forward into child pose.
Return to the start and repeat.

3329.description: A sit up on a roman chair that gives you a big range of motion for your abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the roman chair with your feet locked under the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back slightly.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Pause at the top and keep your neck relaxed.
Lower back slowly under control and repeat.

3393.description: A floor leg raise that lifts the hips off the ground for a stronger lower-abs contraction.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or holding something behind your head.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Lower your legs without arching your back.
Keep movements smooth, not swinging.

3457.description: A burpee that includes a full push-up for conditioning.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up.
Jump your feet in and leap up.
Repeat at a steady pace.

3585.description: A single-leg hip hinge that ends with a knee drive, training balance, hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge forward as the other leg extends behind you.
Return to upright by squeezing the glute.
Drive the free knee up toward your chest.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

3713.description: A one-legged calf raise holding a dumbbell for extra load. It builds calf strength and ankle balance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg, lightly touching a wall for balance.
Rise up onto the ball of your foot as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the start if possible.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3777.description: A front plank with a one-arm band pulldown. It trains core stability while your arm works against the band.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and set up in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Pull the band down with one hand toward your hip without twisting.
Return the arm slowly to the start.
Alternate arms and keep your body in one straight line.

3841.description: A standing side bend against band tension. It trains your obliques.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the handle in one hand.
Keep your chest up and your hips square.
Bend sideways toward the band hand.
Return to upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3905.description: A simple warm-up that loosens the shoulder joints by moving the arms in circles.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Make small circles forward.
Gradually make the circles larger.
Do 10 to 15 circles, then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Breathe normally.

3969.description: Seated or reclined, you pull knees and chest together and then extend out again. It works the abs and hip flexors, especially the lower abs.
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and hold the floor or your sides for support.
Extend your legs out in front, hovering just above the floor.
Pull your knees toward your chest while curling your torso forward.
Pause briefly at the top with your abs tight.
Extend back out under control without letting your feet touch down, and repeat.

4033.description: Standing leg curl using a band around the ankle. It isolates the hamstrings.
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Stand tall facing the anchor and hold a support.
Bend your knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Keep your thighs together and hips still.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

4097.description: A reverse crunch that flows into a dead bug, training lower abs and control of the trunk.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips.
Curl your pelvis off the floor in a reverse crunch.
Lower your hips and extend one leg and the opposite arm.
Return to the start, then repeat on the other side.
Keep your lower back flat.

4161.description: Step back into a lunge and raise the dumbbells in front. It trains the legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your thighs.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you lower, raise the dumbbells in front to shoulder height.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Lower the dumbbells as you return.
Alternate legs for each rep.

4225.description: An upright row done lying on your back with a low cable. The lying position takes your lower back out of the movement.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley.
Hold a bar or handle with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Pull the handle up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Keep the handle close to your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

4353.description: A lying triceps extension on a bench using a cable rope. It keeps constant tension on the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench with your head toward a low pulley and hold the rope above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows and lower the rope behind your head.
Extend your arms to return.
Spread the rope slightly at the end.

4417.description: A wide-stance squat in which you touch the floor between your feet. It trains the glutes, thighs and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and squat down.
Touch the floor with your fingertips between your feet.
Keep your chest lifted and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

4481.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the lower back at a diagonal angle. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your lower back at a diagonal angle while lying on your back with your hips slightly rotated.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep the ball beside the spine, never on it.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4545.description: A one-arm cable kickback that isolates the triceps with constant tension.
instructions: Set a low pulley with a single handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Hold the handle with your elbow bent at your side, upper arm parallel to the floor.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow back.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

4609.description: A gentle lying rotation that sways your bent knees side to side to loosen the lower back and hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent, feet flat.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Slowly drop both knees to one side as far as is comfortable.
Bring them back to the middle and drop them to the other side.
Move at an easy pace and breathe through each rep.

4673.description: A standing or kneeling stretch that lengthens the front of the hip while the glutes work.
instructions: Stand or kneel with one foot forward in a lunge position.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the back glute.
Lean slightly forward to feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

4737.description: Lying on your back with a dumbbell held overhead, you swing your legs side to side like a wiper. It challenges the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back to the middle.
Repeat to the other side, keeping your shoulders flat.

4801.description: A table top bridge with an arm sweep and trunk rotation. It trains the glutes while opening the chest and challenging balance.
instructions: Set up in a table top bridge with hips lifted and hands under your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and both feet.
Lift the free arm and reach it up and over your body as you rotate your chest.
Keep your hips high and level throughout.
Return the arm to the floor and repeat, then switch sides.

4865.description: Walking lunges with dumbbells held overhead. It trains the legs and shoulder stability.
instructions: Hold dumbbells overhead with locked arms.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Push through your front foot.
Step through into the next lunge.

4929.description: A calf stretch done lying on your back. It stretches the lower leg with little effort from the rest of your body.
instructions: Lie on your back and lift one leg toward the ceiling.
Hold behind the thigh or use a strap on your foot.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep the knee as straight as you comfortably can.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

5057.description: Circle your hips in a kneeling position. It warms up the hip joints and glutes.
instructions: Kneel with your hands on your hips.
Push your hips forward slightly.
Draw large circles with your hips, leading forward and around.
Do several circles in one direction.
Switch direction and repeat.

5121.description: Squat with a wide stance holding a dumbbell between your legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Keep your chest tall.
Sit down until your thighs are about parallel.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

5313.description: Blend a good morning hinge with a squat while holding a dumbbell. Builds the posterior chain and legs.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Stand back up and then sit down into a squat.
Drive up through your heels.
Repeat the hinge and squat as one rep.
Keep your chest up throughout.

5377.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the chest. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under one side of your chest.
Place the roller under the chest and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly side to side across the muscle.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5633.description: Back squat with a narrow stance for more quad focus.
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back with feet close together.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up.
Stand back up through your feet.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

5697.description: A chest-supported row done lying face down on an incline bench or rack. With the body supported, it focuses the work on the upper back.
instructions: Lie face down on a raised bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights up toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

5825.description: A reverse lunge using the Smith machine for a fixed bar path. It works the glutes and quads with extra stability.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand tall.
Step one foot back behind you.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5889.description: The classic resting pose at the end of practice. Lets the body relax fully.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and slightly apart.
Let your arms rest by your sides with palms up.
Close your eyes and let your whole body soften.
Breathe slowly for 2-5 minutes.
Roll to your side and sit up gently.

6017.description: A step back with a downward arm pull that fires up the lats and legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms overhead.
Step one foot back.
Pull your elbows down and in as if doing a pulldown.
Return your arms and foot to start.
Alternate legs at a steady pace.

6145.description: A bench-supported reverse hyper with a dumbbell held between your feet. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hold the bench for support.
Raise your legs until they align with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

6209.description: A kneeling kickback with a straight leg on the left side. It targets the glutes.
instructions: Start on all fours.
Extend your left leg straight behind you.
Lift it to hip height.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your hips level.

6465.description: A loaded hip thrust on a Smith machine with the soles of your feet together, strongly targeting the glutes.
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Put the soles of your feet together, knees open.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.

6785.description: A seated move pushing the knees outward against a band. It strengthens the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with a band around your thighs above the knees.
Keep your feet flat and planted.
Press your knees apart against the band.
Hold for a second at the widest point.
Bring the knees back together slowly.

6913.description: A seated drill squeezing the shoulder blades together. It strengthens the muscles that support good posture.
instructions: Sit tall with arms relaxed at your sides or held in front.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Pull your shoulder blades together and slightly down.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

7233.description: A standing shoulder blade rotation that warms up the upper back and improves control of the scapulae.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift your shoulders gently up.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Repeat for the planned reps.

7553.description: Doorway stretch that opens up the chest and the fronts of your shoulders.
instructions: Stand in a doorway with forearms on the frame, elbows at 90 degrees.
Step one foot forward.
Lean gently through the door until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and step back.

7745.description: A face pull using a towel looped around a fixed anchor and an underhand grip. A simple way to train the rear delts without a cable.
instructions: Loop a towel around a sturdy anchor and hold both ends, palms up.
Lean back with your arms extended.
Pull your hands toward your face, elbows wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet in to make it harder.

8193.description: A cable chop that travels from low to high across your body. It trains the obliques and builds rotational power.
instructions: Set the cable low and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Pull it diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and rotate your torso.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.

9025.description: Seated on a ball, you chop diagonally across your body. It trains the obliques and trunk control.
instructions: Sit tall on the ball with your feet wide.
Hold the weight or handle high on one side.
Rotate and chop diagonally down to the opposite hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight and your hips steady.
Return along the same path.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

9409.description: A calf raise with the knees slightly bent while holding a chair. It targets the deeper soleus muscle.
instructions: Stand behind a chair and hold it for balance.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.

9601.description: A step-down drill that builds knee and hip control. It strengthens the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand on a low step on one leg.
Slowly bend the knee and lower the other heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Tap the floor lightly.
Push through the standing leg to rise.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

10049.description: A seated floor press overhead with a barbell and a wide hand position. It builds strong shoulders with a stable trunk.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs out in front and the bar at upper-chest height.
Take a wide grip and brace your abs.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your upper chest under control.
Keep your back tall and avoid arching.
Use a light weight at first.

10113.description: Hold a squat while pressing out against a machine pad. It trains the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Set the machine pads against the outsides of your knees.
Lower into a half squat and keep your chest up.
Press your knees outward against the pads.
Hold the position steadily for the target time.
Release and stand up slowly.

10561.description: A single-leg deadlift where you pass a kettlebell from hand to hand. It trains balance and the hip hinge.
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Hinge at the hips and reach the bell toward the floor.
Pass the bell to the other hand below your knee.
Stand back up using your glute and hamstring.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10753.description: Seated knee raise against band tension. It works the hip flexors and lower abs.
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with a band looped around your foot and anchored low.
Hold the seat edge and brace your core.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the foot slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

10817.description: A forearm drill where you rotate a dumbbell through your palm. It builds wrist and forearm control.
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a bench.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back.
Move slowly with control.
Switch arms.

11265.description: A standing cable knee raise that trains the hip flexors. It helps lifting your leg with control.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley, face away from the machine, and hold on for balance.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Drive your working knee forward and up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

11649.description: A calf stretch with a bent back knee that targets the deeper soleus muscle near the Achilles tendon.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with hands on it and one foot back.
Bend both knees, keeping the back heel flat on the floor.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch low in the back calf.
Keep your hips square and chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

0001.description: A shortened sit-up that stops at about 45 degrees, keeping tension on the abs the whole time.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0065.description: A floor press with one hand on the bar. Limits range of motion to be gentle on the shoulder and trains the triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with one hand, palm facing up, and extend your arm straight up over your chest.
Slowly lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 仰卧在地板上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地面上。
用一只手握住杠铃，掌心朝上，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
慢慢地将杠铃降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0129.description: A bench dip with knees bent. A manageable way to train the triceps.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your butt off the bench and straighten your legs in front of you, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将臀部从长凳上滑下来，在身前伸直双腿，脚后跟保持在地面上。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0193.description: A kneeling one-arm cable row at a higher pulley, pulling straight back to the chest. It targets the upper back, one side at a time.
instructions: Attach a handle to a cable machine at waist height.
Kneel down facing the cable machine and grab the handle with one hand.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the handle towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement.
Slowly release the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with the other arm.
instructionsZh: 将手柄连接到腰部高度的缆绳机上。
面向电缆机跪下，用一只手抓住手柄。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将手柄拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用另一只手臂重复练习。

0257.description: A standing knee circle drill with the heels lifted. It warms up the knees and calves and can ease tight lower legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and lift your heels off the ground, balancing on the balls of your feet.
Keeping your knees bent, rotate your knees in a circular motion, first clockwise and then counterclockwise.
Perform the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手放在臀部。
稍微弯曲膝盖，将脚跟抬离地面，用脚掌保持平衡。
保持膝盖弯曲，先顺时针旋转膝盖，然后逆时针旋转膝盖。
执行所需的重复运动次数。

0321.description: An incline press with dumbbells held palms facing each other. The neutral grip focuses on the upper chest and spares the shoulders.
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lie back on the bench and position the dumbbells at shoulder level with your palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells up and away from your body until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳设置成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
仰卧在长凳上，将哑铃置于与肩同高的位置，手掌相对。
将哑铃向上推离身体，直到手臂完全伸展。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0385.description: With palms down and forearms supported, you curl the dumbbells up with your wrists. It builds the top of the forearms.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the dumbbells towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌朝下。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬在边缘。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将哑铃拉向身体。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0449.description: On an incline bench, you lower an EZ bar behind your head and extend your arms. It stretches and works the triceps.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip.
Extend your arms fully overhead, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，正手握住 ez 杠铃。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部靠近头部。
弯曲肘部，将杠铃降低到头后，保持上臂静止。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0513.description: A bodyweight squat finished with an explosive jump, second variation. It builds leg power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Jump explosively, extending your hips and knees fully.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately lower your body back into a squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发力跳跃，充分伸展臀部和膝盖。
脚掌轻轻着地，然后立即将身体放回蹲姿。
重复所需的重复次数。

0577.description: A machine press where you push the handles forward from your chest. Works the chest, front shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back flat against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, exhaling during the movement.
Pause briefly at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position, inhaling as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，背部平放在垫子上。
正手握住手柄，肘部呈 90 度角。
向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，运动过程中呼气。
动作结束时短暂暂停，然后慢慢回到起始位置，同时吸气。
重复所需的重复次数。

0641.description: A sit-up variation where you curl up with your hands behind your head. Works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0705.description: Lying on your side, you hold your hips up off the floor on your forearm. Works the obliques and core.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
保持此位置所需的时间。
将臀部放低至起始位置。
在另一侧重复。

0769.description: A lunge variation on the smith machine, stepping back and lowering into a lunge. It works the glutes and thighs and challenges balance.
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step back with your right foot and place it on the barbell, resting the top of your foot on the bar.
Bend your left knee and lower your body into a lunge position, keeping your back straight.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping back with your left foot.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃置于臀部高度的史密斯机上。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
右脚向后退一步，将其放在杠铃上，将脚尖放在杠上。
弯曲左膝，将身体降低到弓步位置，保持背部挺直。
推动左脚跟返回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，左脚向后退一步。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0833.description: A donkey calf raise with extra weight, bent at the hips with the toes on a platform. It works the calves through a long range of motion.
instructions: Stand on a raised platform with your toes on the edge and your heels hanging off.
Hold onto a stable object for support.
Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站在一个升高的平台上，脚趾放在边缘，脚后跟悬垂。
抓住一个稳定的物体作为支撑。
伸展脚踝，将脚后跟尽可能抬高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0897.description: A hammer curl with a band. The neutral grip hits the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

0961.description: Balance on one leg with the other foot resting on your inner thigh. It builds balance, focus and hip strength.
instructions: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one foot.
Place the sole of the other foot on your inner calf or thigh, never on the knee.
Bring your palms together at your chest or raise them overhead.
Fix your eyes on one point to stay steady.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch legs.
